title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the systematic repression of human rights in Iran, notably the cases of Pakhshan Azizi and Wrisha Moradi, and the taking of EU citizens as hostages
part_text: Text as a whole without the words: ‘to designate the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps a terrorist organisation and’
part_context: Reiterates its call on the Council <del>to designate the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps a terrorist organisation and</del> to extend EU sanctions to all those responsible for human rights violations, including Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei, President Masoud Pezeshkian, Judiciary Chief Gholam-Hossein Mohseni-Eje’i, Prosecutor-General Mohammad Movahedi-Azad and Judge Iman Afshari;
